spec.name: sprint17_predmkt_spread_monitor
spec.hypothesis: Kalshi and Polymarket price the same resolution event differently by enough, after fees, to be a real (if unharvested-until-measured) cross-venue spread -- documented ~$40M/yr extracted industry-wide, 1.5-4.5% spreads reported (IMDEA); settlement-definition mismatch is the primary risk so matching must be on resolution-criteria text, not titles.
spec.power_argument: No trades yet -- this is the pre-registered MEASUREMENT phase P2 calls for. Target >=300 matched-market spread observations (analog to trade count) across >=20 days of paired snapshots to characterize spread frequency/size distribution before any validation trade spec is written. Min detectable mean spread at t=2, n=300 using an assumed ~3pp cross-venue dispersion (placeholder, not a briefing fact -- must be replaced with measured std after week 1) is ~0.35pp, well under the reported 1.5-4.5pp range, so the design can fail (spreads too rare/thin/fee-eaten) rather than confirm by construction.
symbols: N/A -- event-market pairs, not tickers; universe = markets live on both venues with matching resolution text
